title: TruckDrive paired support to 399 m and cross-dataset long-range review
dataset: TruckDrive official mini scene_28_1; TruckScenes v1.2-mini saved reference
sensor_configuration: Released joint radar, joint Aeva FMCW LiDAR and three Ouster streams; static and acquisition-aligned sensitivity
annotation_schema: Released velodyne-frame oriented cuboids; invalid 3D and ego annotations excluded
split: One mini scene: 200 static paired frames, 198 acquisition-aligned paired frames

measurements.name: Radar returns at or beyond 300 m
measurements.scope: Released joint radar, 200 frames; calibrated planar range, not verified true positives

notes: Geometric support only. A narrow static radar lead for vehicles at 150-200 m reverses with acquisition alignment and track weighting; beyond 200 m both timing variants favour LiDAR support in this scene. Only three vehicle tracks in the aligned 300-400 m band. Joint-cloud internal deskew, annotation bias, dynamic motion and generalisation remain unresolved. External papers are attributed, not new model runs.
